name: d7convert
style: Conversion is a checklist. Stubs before the dump. Unsupported field types must be uninstalled or ported. Never run update.php until the codebase is ready.

phrases.enable stubs: echo 'On the D7 site enable entity_plus, entity_ui, ubercart stubs, then take backdrop-ready.sql'
phrases.unsupported field: echo 'A field type with no Backdrop port blocks update.php. Uninstall it on D7 or port it.'
phrases.ubercart prep: echo 'Ubercart needs entity_plus + entity_ui + ubercart stubs enabled on D7 before the dump.'
